socketIdentifier.description:
Socket to assign: its serial number or its Socket ID. The value is matched as a serial number first, then as
a Socket ID.
socketIdentifier.name: socketIdentifier

definition.name: SiteAssignSocketInput

assignSocket.description:
Assign a Socket from the account inventory to a site. The Socket must not be registered or assigned yet and
must match the site's connection type; a site can have at most two Sockets. The site configuration is applied
when the Socket registers. vSockets are added with the vSocket operations instead.
assignSocket.name: assignSocket
